claims.statement: Revenue growth driven by Enterprise Solutions due to new geographies, upselling, increased deal values in cyber security
FY25 EBITDA margin guided at ~30%, PAT margin at 18-20%
Expect 25-30% revenue growth in coming years based on order book and historical performance
Opening order book for FY25 at Rs 148.6 crore for enterprise solutions, split 74% cybersecurity, 26% paperless
Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 35.2% driven by Trust Services pricing uptick and lower hardware mix
QIP proceeds: Rs 80 crore reserved for acquisitions, Rs 43 crore for three new products (homomorphic encryption, mobile PKI, post-quantum crypto), Rs 10-12 crore spent so far
R&D underway in post-quantum cryptography, fully homomorphic encryption, mobile PKI; emSigner listed on AWS and Azure Marketplace; certified for SAP SuccessFactors
Consolidated revenue guidance of INR 480-500 crores (30-32% growth) includes inorganic acquisitions; EBITDA margin guidance ~18% after UAE tax impact.
US revenue target of USD 40-50 million in 2 years (from ~USD 24 million run-rate including TWO95), potentially including further acquisitions.
First-year success metric: add 4-5 emSigner/MCA customers generating USD 2-3 million incremental product revenue.
TWO95 services margins low (~15-16% EBITDA); blended margin maintained at ~18% via cross-sell of 80-85% gross margin products.
TWO95 team of 50-60 (7-8 in India, rest US); eMudhra building separate product and services sales teams in US under Dubai-based head.
Planning more small acquisitions (product or services) in US and Europe within current financial year, funded partly via QIP proceeds.
Management expects 25-30% growth aligned with prior projection
Order book growth is good and aligned with previous growth
Channel realization may improve to INR 750-800 from INR 300-350; retail realization may drop to INR 1,500 from INR 2,300-2,400 but overall realization expected to improve next quarter
Q1 FY25 EBITDA INR 295 million, up 19% YoY with 31% margin; Net profit INR 182 million, up 11.1% YoY with 19.2% margin
Bangalore and Chennai data centers can cater to trust services growth for at least five years; Amsterdam data center established for European trust services pending accreditation
Net cash used in investing activities Rs 1,496 Mn in H1 FY2025
Revenue guidance of around INR 500 crores with almost 18% PAT for FY25
EBITDA margin 23.7% and PAT margin 15.6% in Q2 FY25; adjusted EBITDA ~26% and adjusted PAT >18.5% after accounting changes
Order book expanding in line with growth; confident of achieving FY25 guidance
Managed services architecture on AWS/Azure; core trust services may need US data centre setup similar to India model
Managed PKI for EU inter-governmental organization
Secure cloud workloads for large ERP platform in North America
Paperless transformation for large Telecom in Asia Pacific
eSignature paperless transformation for large Bank in Qatar
Certificate Lifecycle Management for large bank in Middle East
eSign/eStamping for solar power purchase agreements for state power distribution company in India
FY25 revenue guidance raised to INR 510-520 crores from earlier INR 475-500 crores
FY26 revenue growth guidance of 25-30% with 15-20% organic and 10% acquisitive
FY26 EBITDA margin guidance 23% reported, 25% adjusted; PAT margin 15.5-16%
Q3 FY25 gross margin impacted by CCA guidelines requiring retail pricing and partner commissions of 40-50%
Stock repurchase of INR 2.5-3 crores per quarter impacting gross margin percentage until September next year
One-time expenses of INR 16-17 crores in FY25 including stock options INR 7-8 crores, acquisition interest INR 25-30 lakhs, stock repurchase INR 9 crores, acquisition costs INR 1.5-1.8 crores

Key Q3 wins: managed PKI for EU intergovernmental organization, secured cloud workloads for North America ERP platform, certificate lifecycle for Middle East bank, e-signature for Qatar bank, paperless transformation for APAC telecom, e-sig
Evaluating EU acquisition up to EUR 10-12 million revenue size at 10x EBITDA or 1x revenue; target must be turnable to 15% EBITDA via India cost transfer
Appointed European CEO Carmine Auletta (ex-InfoCert COO) to drive EU acquisition and partnerships; building global partner program with 2,000 partners across strategic, growth and other tiers
FY26 Order Book Rs 1,907 Mn, 28.3% YoY growth (Enterprise Solutions only)
Estimated R&D spend 7-9% of revenue for FY26
Estimated stock repurchase Rs 25-35 Mn per quarter for FY26
FY26 focus on expansion into European Union
Estimated ESOP provision Rs 110 Mn for FY26
Estimated notional interest on acquisition liability Rs 10 Mn for FY26
Targets 25-30% revenue growth for FY26 with stable EBITDA and PAT margins despite one-off expenses
Enterprise solution order book stands at INR 190 crores
No further data center spending planned; FY26 capex focused on product development at 7-9% of revenue
International enterprise margins declined due to higher services mix and senior hires; Trust Services margins fell due to regulatory billing changes
India Enterprise gross margin improved from 66% to 80-85% by stopping hardware bundling
US data center being set up by shifting Amsterdam equipment to Salt Lake City and New Jersey; no new data center capex
Conservative projection EUR 15-16 million revenue in 4 years; optimistic projection EUR 20 million
Target to reach 20% EBITDA margins in 2 years via cost savings and offshore shift
Current Cryptas profitability slightly less but EBITDA positive; expect considerable improvement over 2-3 years
Plan to offshore low-end work and other operations to India to reduce cost base
Estimated $1 million annual savings plus incremental revenue from product replacement and cross-sell
Cryptas has 50 employees all based in Europe; plan to hire offshore in India for growth
FY26 revenue guidance updated to INR 675-700 crore including Cryptas acquisition
FY26 PAT margin expected around 16-16.5% despite Cryptas integration impact
Enterprise order book grew 28% year-over-year
U.S. data center on-premise setup ready, audit certificate expected by mid-August

Cryptas acquisition expected to turn profitable within next 2 quarters
Cash balance expected to reach INR 125-140 crores by FY26 end with no further acquisition payments planned
Q2 FY26 EBITDA margin 24.8%, PAT margin 15.1%; H1 FY26 EBITDA margin 25%, PAT margin 15.8%

Key wins: CERTInext for North America security firm, emCA for Malaysia government, CLM for UAE authority, emSigner for Qatar bank and India state government, PKI/CLM services for German retail group
INR 54-55 crores capitalized R&D for full year on 3 product development areas; INR 30 crores capex spent in H1 on 3 products
US data centers in New Jersey and Salt Lake City fully audited and operational; issuing certificates from US infrastructure
FY27 organic revenue growth expected at 15-18%, PAT growth at 25-30%, aim to double PAT in 3 years

Data centers operating in US, Europe, UAE, India to meet data sovereignty requirements; multi-region footprint addresses jurisdictional processing needs
Product gross margin higher than services/trust services; rising product mix drives PAT growth of 27-28% vs 18% revenue growth

EBITDA margin 26.2% in Q1; management expects to maintain EBITDA ~25% and PAT ~16-16.5% for FY27

TLS incident expected to reduce FY27 total income by INR 20-23 crore and PAT by INR 10-12 crore, largely in H2
Incident impact expected to last only next two quarters, then business as usual
